tooltip.meridian.enchlib.curve_rule: Each level costs double the points of the last (1, 2, 4, 8, …)
advancements.meridian.root.title: Meridian
advancements.meridian.root.description: Collect any Meridian shelf to start shaping your enchanting stats.
advancements.meridian.stone_tier.title: Stone Foundations
advancements.meridian.stone_tier.descrip: Craft a Hellshelf, Seashelf, or Dormant Deepshelf to begin Eterna progression.
advancements.meridian.tier_three.title: Infused Mastery
advancements.meridian.tier_three.descrip: Craft an Infused Hellshelf, Infused Seashelf, or Deepshelf through the stat-gated table.
advancements.meridian.library.title: The Enchantment Library
advancements.meridian.library.descriptio: Craft an Enchantment Library to pool enchanted books by level.
advancements.meridian.ender_library.desc: Upgrade the Library to a Library of Alexandria at the enchanting table.
advancements.meridian.tome_apprentice.de: Craft a Scrap Tome to salvage enchantments from any tool or weapon.
advancements.meridian.tome_master.title: Tome Master
advancements.meridian.tome_master.descri: Craft an Extraction Tome to pull every enchantment without destroying the item.
advancements.meridian.warden_tendril.des: Claim a Warden Tendril from the depths — required for sculk-tier shelves.
advancements.meridian.infused_breath.des: Refine Dragon's Breath into Infused Breath at a high-Eterna table.
advancements.meridian.apotheosis.title: Apotheosis
advancements.meridian.apotheosis.descrip: Reach maximum enchanting power — hit Eterna 50 and take the top-slot enchant.
advancements.meridian.sculk_mastery.desc: Craft an Echoing or Soul-Touched Sculkshelf — the pinnacle of enchanting power.
Craft a Rectifier shelf to gain control over enchantment stability.
advancements.meridian.all_seeing.title: All-Seeing
advancements.meridian.all_seeing.descrip: Craft a Hellshelf of Masterful Sight to reveal all enchantment clues.
advancements.meridian.curator.title: The Curator
advancements.meridian.curator.descriptio: Craft a Filtering Shelf to blacklist unwanted enchantments from your table.
advancements.meridian.treasure_seeker.de: Craft a Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures to unlock treasure-tier enchantments at the table.
advancements.meridian.web_spinner.title: Web Spinner
advancements.meridian.web_spinner.descri: Obtain a Prismatic Web — the key to removing curses from enchanted gear.
advancements.meridian.high_quanta.title: Chaotic Enchanter
advancements.meridian.high_quanta.descri: Enchant an item with Quanta above 60 — embrace the chaos.
advancements.meridian.high_arcana.title: Arcane Scholar
advancements.meridian.high_arcana.descri: Enchant an item with Arcana above 60 — command the rarest enchantments.
config.meridian.title: Meridian Configuration
gui.meridian.enchant_info.title: Available Enchantments
gui.meridian.stat.eterna.formula: Each point of Eterna raises the max enchanting level by 2
gui.meridian.stat.quanta.formula: Quanta %% is the most the level can randomly swing up or down
gui.meridian.stat.arcana.desc3: and increases the number of enchantments
gui.meridian.stat.arcana.formula: Higher Arcana skews the odds toward rarer enchantments and can guarantee extra ones
info.meridian.prismatic_web: Can be used to remove curses in an anvil.
info.meridian.infused_breath: Crafting material for endgame shelves and libraries.
info.meridian.dormant_core: Inert, wrested from a slain Ender Dragon. A sufficiently powerful enchanting table might ignite it.
info.meridian.tempered_core: Combine with a tool or armor piece in an anvil to make it unbreakable.
info.meridian.everfeast: An infused ration that feeds you many times over.
info.meridian.scrap_tome: Extracts one random enchantment from an item.
info.meridian.scrap_tome2: Destroys the item in the process.
info.meridian.improved_scrap_tome: Extracts all enchantments from an item.
info.meridian.improved_scrap_tome2: Destroys the item in the process.
info.meridian.extraction_tome: Extracts all enchantments from an item.
info.meridian.dormant_xp_tome: Activate at the enchanting table to store experience.
info.meridian.beeshelf: Trades enchanting level for maximum chaos — levels can swing wildly either way.
info.meridian.melonshelf: Calms the table: reduces the random level swing at a small cost to enchanting level.
info.meridian.stoneshelf: Dampens the table, lowering enchanting level and making rare enchantments less likely.
info.meridian.hellshelf: A basic Nether shelf that raises the max enchanting level, with a touch of chaos.
info.meridian.blazing_hellshelf: A potent Nether shelf pushing enchanting level high, but it hides one clue.
info.meridian.glowing_hellshelf: A refined Nether shelf that raises the enchanting level and nudges the odds toward rarer enchantments.
info.meridian.infused_hellshelf: An infused Nether shelf offering steady enchanting level with mild chaos.
info.meridian.seashelf: A basic ocean shelf that raises the max enchanting level and slightly favors rarer enchantments.
info.meridian.heart_seashelf: An ocean shelf that strongly favors rarer enchantments, at a small cost to stability.
info.meridian.crystal_seashelf: A balanced ocean shelf: enchanting level, a little chaos, and rarer enchantments.
info.meridian.infused_seashelf: An infused ocean shelf offering steady enchanting level and rarer enchantments, with no added chaos.
info.meridian.endshelf: An End shelf that supports high enchanting levels with modest chaos and rarity bonuses.
info.meridian.pearl_endshelf: A pearl-studded End shelf granting strong enchanting level, chaos, and rarity all at once.
info.meridian.draconic_endshelf: The pinnacle of raw power: a huge enchanting level boost with no chaos at all.
info.meridian.deepshelf: A deep-dark shelf granting solid enchanting level and a lean toward rarer enchantments.
info.meridian.dormant_deepshelf: A sleeping deep-dark shelf with a faint enchanting level bonus. It could be awakened.
info.meridian.echoing_deepshelf: An awakened deep-dark shelf that strongly favors rarer enchantments.
info.meridian.soul_touched_deepshelf: An awakened deep-dark shelf that adds a heavy dose of chaos.
info.meridian.echoing_sculkshelf: A sculk shelf strongly favoring rarer enchantments; reveals one clue.
info.meridian.soul_touched_sculkshelf: A sculk shelf of high enchanting level and chaos, with a touch of Rectification.
info.meridian.sightshelf: Reveals one enchantment clue, showing part of what the table will actually give you.
info.meridian.sightshelf_t2: Reveals two enchantment clues, showing more of what the table will actually give you.
info.meridian.rectifier: Steers chaos upward: random level swings become a bit more likely to help than hurt.
info.meridian.rectifier_t2: A stronger rectifier — random level swings lean further in your favor.
info.meridian.rectifier_t3: A master rectifier — random level swings lean strongly in your favor.
info.meridian.filtering_shelf: Insert single-enchantment enchanted books to prevent those enchantments from appearing in the enchanting table.
info.meridian.filtering_shelf2: Gains bonus Eterna and Arcana for each inserted book.
